posts.title: Why I don't feel AI will kill media as art
posts.description: AI may flood the internet with cheap imitations, but art is more than content. People value the human perspectives and connections behind it.

posts.title: How to save and load schematics with WorldEdit
posts.description: Learn how to load and paste schematic files into Minecraft with WorldEdit, and even make your own to share with friends or the internet!

posts.title: Taking a week off open-source support
posts.description: For 14 years, I provided open-source software support every day. Taking a week off might not sound like much, but I felt I needed to break the habit.
